_comment: Syllable grammars for words.syllabic and words.brand. A word is syllable{2,4}; a syllable is onset? nucleus coda?. Flavours are pure weight tables, so adding one is a JSON edit and no PHP change. Weights are relative within their own table, never probabilities, so a table can be tuned by nudging one number without renormalising the rest. The empty string key means 'nothing here' — a bare nucleus for onset, an open syllable for coda. The 'final' block decides how the last syllable closes: 'coda' uses a separate (usually heavier) coda table, 'open' forces a vowel ending, 'suffix' replaces the last nucleus+coda with a fixed ending such as -us or -um.

elvish.label: Elvish
elvish.note: Liquids, open syllables and no hard stops — the sound is carried by l, r, th and long vowels.

nordic.label: Nordic
nordic.note: Consonant clusters, hard k and g, and the Scandinavian vowels ø and å.

brand.label: Brand
brand.note: Two open syllables ending in a vowel — the shape every startup name has had since 2010.

latin.label: Latin
latin.note: Classical shapes closed with -us, -a or -um, the way half of taxonomy and all of pharma name things.
